summary_en: On the morning of Sept. 24 local time, Chinese President Xi Jinping and U.S. President Trump held talks at the White House. Xi noted the unprecedented mutual visits by the two heads of state within six months; the two sides decided to build a constructive, strategically stable China-U.S. relationship and work toward cooperation as the mainstay, limited competition, controllable differences, and foreseeable peace. summary_en: Ding Xuexiang Meets with Kazakhstan's First Deputy Prime Minister Nalibayev. In July this year, President Xi Jinping met with President Tokayev, charting the course for developing bilateral relations and deepening practical cooperation. As co-chairs of the China-Kazakhstan Cooperation Committee, the two sides should fully implement the important consensus reached by the two heads of state.

summary: 9月21日至22日，全国人大常委会副委员长丁仲礼应韩国国会邀请率团访问韩国，会见韩国国会议长赵正湜，并与副议长南仁顺共同出席中韩议会交流机制第十四次会议。丁仲礼表示，当前国际形势纷繁复杂，中韩应坚守建交初心、坚定睦邻友好、坚持互利共赢，落实
summary_en: From September 21 to 22, Ding Zhongli, Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, led a delegation to visit South Korea at the invitation of the South Korean National Assembly. He met with Speaker of the National Assembly Cho Jung-sik and, together with Deputy Speaker Nam In-soon, attended the 14th meeting of the China-South Korea parliamentary exchange mechanism. Ding Zhongli said that the current international situation is complex and volatile, and China and South Korea should adhere to the original aspiration of establishing diplomatic relations, uphold good-neighborliness and friendship, and pursue mutual benefit and win-win results, and implement the important consensus reached by the leaders of the two countries.

title_en: After 18 years of green development and innovation, the 18-year-old Sino-Singapore Tianjin Eco-City strides toward a new green future
summary: 中新天津生态城迎来开发建设18周年，昔日盐碱荒滩已变为“一座轻轻放进大自然的城”，并启动国家绿色发展示范区升级版建设。产业方面，聚焦绿色低碳、数字经济、生命健康、海洋文旅等主导产业，一汽丰田新能源工厂、中国资源循环集团总部、北方大数据交易中
summary_en: The China-Singapore Tianjin Eco-City marked the 18th anniversary of its development and construction. The once saline-alkali wasteland has become "a city gently placed in nature," and it has launched the upgraded construction of a national green development demonstration zone. In terms of industry, it focuses on leading sectors such as green and low-carbon, digital economy, life and health, and marine culture and tourism. Projects including the FAW Toyota new energy vehicle plant, the headquarters of China Resources Recycling Group, and the Northern Big Data Exchange Center have been introduced.

summary_en: The 1,200-unit social housing project in Mauritius built by Beijing Construction Engineering Group has been completed and handed over. title: “中华民族一家亲”图片展在莫斯科举行

summary_en: The photo exhibition "One Family of the Chinese Nation" was held in Moscow, featuring 39 selected Xinhua News Agency photographs vividly depicting the integration, coexistence and united development of all ethnic groups in China. summary_en: On the morning of Sept 25 local time, the Chinese Navy hospital ship 'Auspicious Ark' on the Mission Harmony-2026 arrived in Dakar, Senegal, for a friendly visit and to provide medical services. This is the first visit by a Chinese Navy hospital ship to Senegal. During the visit, the hospital ship used its main platform to provide medical services and sent medical training teams.

summary_en: Han Zheng Meets with Cambodian King Norodom Sihamoni and Queen Mother Norodom Monineath. Han Zheng conveyed the cordial greetings and best wishes of President Xi Jinping and Madame Peng Liyuan, saying that the ironclad friendship between China and Cambodia was jointly forged and carefully nurtured by the older generation of leaders of the two countries and has withstood storms and remained rock-solid. Under the strategic guidance of the leaders of the two countries, bilateral relations have entered a new stage of building a China-Cambodia community with a shared future in the new era.
